verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents one built-in AI feature, Query Assistant, which turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. That is a narrow, single-purpose delegation rather than a general in-product assistant. The MCP server and agent skills serve external AI agents, not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that can take on broader tasks (investigation, Board/Trigger creation), multi-step agentic execution inside the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Query Assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
